scope: Provisional source evidence and person-travel scenarios, not ownership, military control or absent communities. No road-cell authority sources; no extra refuge/rank/power multipliers. Same-site return uses max(outward,return) within each supplied per-leg budget. Common central-density transport includes proposed tracks/ports; source scenarios isolate affiliation/site additions only. Additive beat-or-wait sailing and minimum parallel alternatives; all conditions held at one model month. Unknown marked sites are a separate evidence signal, never an invented polity. Missing actor inventories are unscored, not zero actual control.
